Steam > steamapps > common > Stardew Valley > Mods

[b]How to use[/b]
Change your horse into a fox or red panda by using the scissors from the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]alternative textures[/url]﻿ mod. Simply click on the horse while holding the scissors to change textures![/center]
